name: GraphwakeUpload
description: Send your service's OpenAPI spec to Graphwake from pull request and default-branch builds. Never fails the pipeline.
helpMarkDown: Downloads the graphwake agent (checksum verified) and runs `graphwake upload`. See https://github.com/graphwake/agent.
author: Graphwake

inputs.name: spec
inputs.label: Spec
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the OpenAPI spec file, or an http(s) URL to read it from.

inputs.name: key
inputs.label: Ingest key
inputs.helpMarkDown: The service's ingest key. Use a secret variable, e.g. $(GRAPHWAKE_KEY).

inputs.name: liveBranch
inputs.label: Live branches
inputs.helpMarkDown: Branches whose builds publish the live spec, comma-separated, globs allowed (e.g. main,release/*). Default: main or master.
